newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soyoil futures traded record volume Friday.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soyoil futures traded record volume Friday.

text.p: CBOT soybean oil futures traded record volume on Friday in active dealings tied to a surprisingly bullish crop report issued by the U.S. Agriculture Department.
Soyoil futures traded 56,858 contracts on Friday, topping the previous record of 56,245 contracts set on June 28, 1988, CBOT said.
"I was just floored with the volume that was traded," said Dave Armstrong, an analyst with ABN-AMRO Chicago Corp. "Clearly it was the crop report that made it go."
USDA Friday pegged 1996 U.S. soybean production at 2.382 billion bushels, below average expectations for 2.407 billion.
USDA said the 1996-97 U.S. soybean carryover would total 155 million bushels, below the previous forecast for 180 million bushels.
